items.headline: 诺贝尔化学奖：分子的“左右手”
items.headline_en: Chemistry Nobel: Why Molecular Handedness Matters
items.summary: 许多分子像左右手，互为镜像却可能药效不同。10月7日揭晓的诺贝尔化学奖，表彰将微小手性偏向放大的反应研究，帮助合成更多所需的一种。
items.summary_en: Many molecules have mirror-image forms with different biological effects. The chemistry Nobel, announced on 7 October, honours reactions that amplify a small preference for one form, helping chemists make the version they need.

items.headline: AI找到耐热mRNA疫苗新配方
items.headline_en: AI Helps RNA Vaccines Withstand Heat
items.summary: 研究者用AI调配保护成分，让干燥mRNA疫苗在室温保存一年后，仍能在小鼠中诱发免疫反应。若经人体试验验证，或能降低偏远地区的疫苗配送门槛。
items.summary_en: AI optimized protective ingredients around mRNA-carrying particles. After a year at room temperature, dried vaccines still triggered immune responses in mice. Human validation is needed, but the approach could ease cold-chain barriers to vaccination.

items.headline: 美电动车销量降，用电为何仍升？
items.headline_en: EV Sales Fall, So Why Does Electricity Use Rise?
items.summary: 2026上半年，美国电动车新车销量比前半年降19%，轻型电动车用电量估算却增8%。此前售出的车仍在跑：新增销量与在用车队，是不同的概念。
items.summary_en: In January–June 2026, U.S. EV sales fell 19% from July–December 2025, but estimated light-duty EV electricity use rose 8%. Existing vehicles still need charging; new sales do not measure the whole fleet.

items.headline: 厄尔尼诺增强，电网为何承压？
items.headline_en: How Can El Niño Put Power Supplies Under Pressure?
items.summary: NOAA周报显示厄尔尼诺正在增强。IEA指出，部分拉美地区少雨会减少水库来水，高温又增加空调用电；发电减少、需求增加，可能同时挤压电网。
items.summary_en: NOAA’s latest update shows El Niño strengthening. The IEA explains the double squeeze on parts of Latin America: reduced rainfall can cut hydropower, while heat increases cooling demand. Weather can disrupt both electricity supply and demand.

items.headline: AI设计的蛋白质也能加水印
items.summary: 研究者微调氨基酸选择，为AI设计的蛋白质嵌入可检测水印，同时保留实验中的结合功能。这为追踪合成生物来源提供新方法，但水印仍可能被刻意移除。
items.summary_en: Researchers embedded detectable signatures in AI-designed protein sequences while preserving binding function in laboratory tests. Biological watermarking could help trace synthetic designs and protect scientific databases, but the proof of concept remains vulnerable to deliberate removal.

items.headline: 雷达卫星把火山变化连成时间序列
items.headline_en: Radar Satellites Track How Volcanoes Change
items.summary: NASA发布的NISAR成果用17次雷达观测记录熔岩扩展。卫星主动发射微波、接收回波成像，规律重访同一区域，让缺少地面仪器的火山也能持续积累变化记录。
items.summary_en: NASA released NISAR results tracking spreading lava through 17 radar observations. The satellite sends microwaves and measures echoes, repeatedly revisiting the same area to build records of changes even where ground instruments are scarce.

challenges.headline: 把1至9按顺序写成3×3方格：第一行1、2、3，第二行4、5、6，第三行7、8、9。圈出3个数，每行、每列恰好一个。总和最大能是多少？为什么？
challenges.headline_en: Write 1–9 in a 3×3 grid, with rows 1,2,3; 4,5,6; and 7,8,9. Circle three numbers, exactly one in each row and column. What is the largest possible sum? Why?

challenges.headline: 模拟测试：10000条消息中有100条垃圾信息。筛选器标记了其中90条，又误标其余9900条中的1%。从被标记的消息中等概率抽一条，它真是垃圾信息的概率是多少？
challenges.headline_en: A simulated test has 10,000 messages, including 100 spam messages. A filter flags 90 of the spam messages and 1% of the other 9,900 messages. Pick uniformly from the flagged messages. What is the probability it is actually spam?

challenges.headline: 在边长10米的正方形内或边界上任放5个传感器。证明：至少两个的直线距离不超过5√2米。能保证不超过7米吗？请说明理由。
challenges.headline_en: Place five sensors anywhere inside or on a square of side 10 m. Prove that some pair is at most 5√2 m apart. Can you always guarantee a pair at most 7 m apart? Justify your answer.
